text.tspan: The shift, enter, backspace buttons are coloured and double up on pads for the function.
Spacebar is the bottom row of 6 pads. Once the name has been typed in it is confirmed /
saved by pressing ‘RETURN’ i.e. ‘amount’ or ‘note’ pads lit green.
